name: chat-composer
$comment: CHAT-15 parity fixture for the v9.1.0 ChatComposerNode composite (Plan 30-07). EVERY branch documented in .planning/phases/30-*/CONTEXT.md §Wire shape has a distinctive expectBodyContains tripwire per AGENTS.md gotcha #9 class-3 lesson (branches the fixture never runs are invisible to the byte-diff). Additionally, the parity harness's ALWAYS-ON findNulls invariant (run.ts) catches the class-2 defect from AGENTS.md gotcha #8 (an unset nullable emitted as `"field": null` instead of ABSENT would be filtered by normalize.ts BEFORE the diff, hiding the drift — findNulls runs on the raw parsed body per response, so it CAN see what the normalized diff cannot). The 5 branches: (a) IDLE — the default composer shape; asserts "type":"chat-composer" + "bind":"chatComposerDraft" + "sendAction":{"name":"chat-composer-send"} + "attachAction":{"name":"chat-composer-attach"} cross (status/dropScope/submitMode/stopAction/headerSlot all ABSENT per gotcha #8 — the findNulls invariant is the tripwire for their absence). (b) STREAMING — asserts "status":"streaming" + "stopAction":{"name":"chat-composer-stop"} cross (the send-button state machine's Streaming arm from Plan 30-01/30-02 CHAT-09). (c) ATTACH-CLICKED — asserts the server-emitted headerSlot TextNode's UNIQUE substring `ChatComposerAttached=true tripwire` (branded to no other emission anywhere in the FeatureProbe wire — a mutation-proof tripwire; a backend that silently dropped the branch would fail LOUDLY because no other code path can produce that substring). Chip strip rendering is CLIENT-SIDE only (attachments live in the local File registry not state), so the branch-C wire tripwire is a server-emitted marker. (d) DROPSCOPE-GLOBAL — asserts "dropScope":"global" (the closed-enum wire value, more diff-robust than the DOM attribute; the client-side scope-of-drop-listener attach is browser-only). (e) SUBMITMODE-CTRL-ENTER — asserts "submitMode":"ctrl-enter" (the kebab wire value confirmed by grep of viewmodel-shell/src/index.ts:2581 + viewmodel-shell-dotnet/ViewModels.cs:313 KebabEnum<ChatComposerSubmitMode>). If a future refactor stops rendering the chat-composer type OR drops the kebab in submitMode OR breaks the streaming/stopAction pairing OR emits `null` for a nullable that should be absent, the corresponding step fails LOUDLY. Do NOT weaken these tripwires without a plan-authored rationale — they are the class-3 tripwire that stops the SEEDED-helpdesk-style pattern from recurring. Steps run sequentially and mutate state cumulatively (streaming carries into attach carries into dropscope carries into submitmode) — each step's assertion is a UNIQUE substring for its own branch that carry-over from prior branches does NOT satisfy (streaming's "status":"streaming" is not emitted by the idle default; attach's tripwire text is not emitted anywhere else; dropscope's kebab enum is closed; submitmode's kebab enum is closed).

steps.$comment: Branch (a) IDLE. All optional axes ABSENT — status/stopAction/dropScope/submitMode/headerSlot omitted. The always-on findNulls invariant proves the absent-not-null contract per gotcha #8.

Branch (b) STREAMING. Server sets state.ChatComposerStatus=streaming + state.ChatComposerHasStopAction=true; buildVm emits the pair. Neither substring is emitted anywhere else in FeatureProbe — the tripwire is mutation-proof against 'silent branch drop'.

Branch (c) ATTACH-CLICKED. Server toggles state.ChatComposerAttached; buildVm emits a headerSlot TextNode carrying this UNIQUE substring. The client-side chip strip render is browser-only (attachments live in the local File registry not state) — the wire tripwire is a server-emitted marker. This substring appears NOWHERE else in the FeatureProbe wire; a backend that silently dropped the branch would fail LOUDLY.

Branch (d) DROPSCOPE-GLOBAL. Server sets state.ChatComposerDropScope=global; buildVm emits dropScope on the wire. The closed-enum kebab "global" is more diff-robust than a DOM attribute (the wire is what parity diffs). The client-side drop-listener attach scope is browser-only.

Branch (e) SUBMITMODE-CTRLENTER. Server sets state.ChatComposerSubmitMode=ctrl-enter; buildVm emits the kebab-wire value. The kebab "ctrl-enter" is confirmed by viewmodel-shell/src/index.ts:2581 (TS union literal) + viewmodel-shell-dotnet/ViewModels.cs:313 (KebabEnum<ChatComposerSubmitMode>). A drift to "ctrlEnter" or "CtrlEnter" would fail this step LOUDLY (a real class of drift the byte-diff also catches, but the tripwire binds it INDEPENDENTLY on each backend per gotcha #9's class-2 lesson).
